Sends custom headers on same-host crawl requests

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["customHeaders" => ["acceptLanguage" => "en-US", "xCustomHeader" => "test-value"], "maxDepth" => 1, "respectRobotsTxt" => false, "subdomainHeaderAllowlist" => ["Accept-Language"]]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::crawl($engine, $url);
var_dump(count($result->getPages()));
```
